description: Roll out Pod Security Standards across all namespaces in a staging cluster using a three-phase approach. First, enable audit mode across all namespaces for 72 hours to identify violations without disrupting workloads. Second, switch to warn mode for 48 hours to surface warnings in pod creation logs. Third, enforce the baseline profile on all namespaces. Legacy namespaces with privileged workloads may need namespace-level label exemptions. Generate a compliance audit report for stakeholders before the enforcement phase begins.
